# Real GitHub advisory fixtures

These files are genuine, **unmodified** records from the GitHub Advisory Database
(https://github.com/github/advisory-database), copied from commit `d30808a2d253959aa15d41c6883eef4a912e12c1`.
They are used to check AdvisoryGuard for false positives/negatives on real data.

belong to their respective authors and GitHub. Each file can be verified byte-for-byte against
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/advisory-database/d30808a2d253959aa15d41c6883eef4a912e12c1/<path>`.
